reasoning: Shows the standard pictogram of a person walking with a long forward-probing cane, universally recognized for blindness/visual impairment and also widely used for elderly mobility or cane use. It fits a clear niche of tasks around low-vision aids, web accessibility/screen-reader testing, and senior mobility care, though it can be confused with general walking or hiking icons at tiny sizes.
